common.toHint: Leave as is for your own account.
common.butrauth: Signed in with Butter Auth: you approve this with your Hive wallet or your active key in the next step.
common.insufficient: That is more than you have.
common.invalidAccount: There is no Hive account with that name.
common.done: Done. It can take a few seconds to show here.

powerUp.title: Power up
powerUp.note: Hive Power gives your votes weight and earns curation rewards. Turning it back into HIVE takes 13 weekly payments.

powerDown.title: Power down
powerDown.note: Hive Power comes back as HIVE in 13 weekly payments, about {{weekly}} HP a week.
powerDown.replace: A power down is running ({{left}} HP left). Starting a new one replaces it.

savings.title: Savings
savings.depositNote: HBD in savings earns {{rate}}% a year. Taking it out takes 3 days.
savings.depositNoteHive: HIVE in savings earns no interest. Taking it out takes 3 days.
savings.withdrawNote: Arrives in 3 days. You can cancel it until then.

convert.title: Convert
convert.hbdNote: You get about {{amount}} HIVE in 3.5 days, at the median price of those days. The final amount can differ.
convert.hiveNote: You get about {{amount}} HBD now. Half of your HIVE is held as collateral and the rest comes back in 3.5 days. A 5% fee applies.
convert.warning: A conversion cannot be undone. Trading on a market can be cheaper.

delegate.title: Delegate
delegate.note: Delegated Hive Power stays yours, but gives its votes to the other account. When you remove it, it takes 5 days to come back.
delegate.current: You delegate {{hp}} HP to @{{to}} now. This sets a new amount.
delegate.removed: Delegation removed. The HP comes back in 5 days.

pending.title: In progress
pending.powerDown: Power down: {{weekly}} HP a week, {{weeks}} weeks left
pending.cancelled: Withdrawal cancelled. The funds stay in savings.
